profile.headline: Software Developer at World Book
profile.summary:
I am a Software Engineer at World Book with over 5 years of experience working on enterprise level web applications. My interests include web/mobile development, UI/UX design, game design, computer security, and GIS. I have work experience in full stack web development using Java, Angular 9+, and PostgreSQL, with a focus on UI implementation. I also have programmed in C#, Python and JavaScript in my academic and game design projects. Alongside my degree, I have earned the Practical Aspects of Computer Security Certificate (PACS) at University of Michigan-Dearborn.

As a passionate learner, I think the study of computing is wonderful because it can be applied in virtually all fields. My current active goal is to build upon my skills in API development, DevOps, and UI/UX design.

projects.title: iOS App Design
projects.description: For my senior design team project, we are currently designing a iOS mobile application to provide our client's customers with a mobile shopping or selling experience. The app is being developed with Xamarin and will allow users to browse, purchase, and sell products directly off their iOS device.

projects.title: 3D Game design II project
projects.description: I am currently the team lead for a 3D fighting game project using Unreal Engine 4.
